Embedding vector width is not uniformly checked against row metadata; no concrete downstream data-integrity failure established in this models-only pass. Existing matrix intentionally uses synthetic one-element vectors, so its pass is not evidence for real vendor dimensions.
Shared SSRF preflight DNS and context-free storage resolver callback cancellation remain outside this models-only change scope.

Uninspected test files remain explicitly pending in per-file reading coverage; this does not mean their scenarios were not executed. Long-duration resource/heap stress beyond bounded image fixtures not performed.
source_audit.fixture_correction: Initial temporary cross-protocol POST fixture did not consume the request body, so HTTP/1 server contexts could not observe disconnects before headers (8 false-negative server-observation checks while callers already returned). Corrected fixture consumes POST body and all 16 cases pass. This is a harness issue, not a product finding; initial log retained separately.
